narrative.introduction: Animal protein foods include meat, poultry, game, and seafood used as the primary protein on the plate — the fat content, texture, and cooking method of each cut anchors its wine pairing logic.
narrative.seo_description: Meat, poultry, game, and seafood proteins organized by biological group and cut, each with its own wine pairing logic based on fat, texture, and cooking ...
narrative.summary: Meat, poultry, game, and seafood proteins organized by biological group and cut, each with its own wine pairing logic based on fat, texture, and cooking method.

narrative.introduction: Fungi protein foods include culinary mushrooms and fermented mycoprotein — umami-rich, plant-adjacent proteins spanning whole mushrooms and processed mycoprotein products.
narrative.seo_description: Mushrooms and mycoprotein bring umami-rich, plant-adjacent protein to the plate, from delicate cultivated varieties to hearty meat-alternative forms.
narrative.summary: Mushrooms and mycoprotein bring umami-rich, plant-adjacent protein to the plate, from delicate cultivated varieties to hearty meat-alternative forms.

narrative.introduction: Plant protein foods include legumes, soy, grains, nuts, and seeds — foundational for vegetarian pairing and flexitarian plates, where botanical character rather than animal cuts drives pairing.
narrative.seo_description: Legumes, soy foods, grains, nuts, and seeds bring plant-based protein to the plate, foundational for vegetarian and flexitarian pairing.
narrative.summary: Legumes, soy foods, grains, nuts, and seeds bring plant-based protein to the plate, foundational for vegetarian and flexitarian pairing.
